_note: The eligibility control on /select-eligibility, captured live 2026-09-15 with the list open, plus the per-category subcategory lists. Unlike the I-485 (three cascading controls: who -> which track -> which relationship) the I-131 has TWO levels: one category Select, then a subcategory radio list for the 4 categories that have one. Codes are the `data-value` observed on the [role=option] elements for the top-level list, and the metadata API's subcategory `category` codes for the radio lists. The subcategory radio group is named '<eligibility-choice value>-subcategories', e.g. 'ADVANCE_PAROLE-subcategories'. ADVANCE_PAROLE's subcategory list was verified live against the DOM; the other three were read from GET /pdf-intake/api/intake/forms/I-131/metadata, which matched the DOM exactly everywhere both were seen.

_evidence_note: THE EVIDENCE SLOT LIST VARIES BY CATEGORY - the I-485's fixed 14-slot list does not carry over. Verified live for two categories: ADVANCE_PAROLE renders 5 slots and REENTRY_PERMIT renders 3, and both matched this metadata exactly. Every category carries applicant-photo, photo-id and additional-evidence; the middle slots are what change. Subcategories can further REMOVE slots via evidenceCategoriesToExclude (e.g. ADVANCE_PAROLE + DEFERRED_ENFORCED_DEPARTURE drops form-i-797 and form-i-797c) - not verified live.
